build: Verified official Node 24.7.0 archive; npm ci with committed package-lock, --ignore-scripts excludes unrelated Husky prepare hook. npm run build executes actual tsc. Task-local npm cache/home/config only; no global installation.
safe_target_scope: Every scenario passes --directory data --targets node_modules; data is copied synthetic managed fixture. Neither --full nor --delete-all nor file-explorer actions are used. Explicit --no-check-update disables network; --no-age excludes live age measurement via supported public flag.

findings.detail: Initial node_modules anchor ambiguous; beta path already existed before filtering and was correctly rejected as stale. Earlier positive presence checks plus disappearance checks prove filtering; actual baseline includes beta result.
Trailing-space anchors are trimmed by public recorder controls; use explicit previous search-state/absence and reviewed settled result snapshot, not whitespace to distinguish state.

snapshot_scopes: Physical rows8..11 filtered/deleted path with actual status/size, rows8..12 resized selected Result Details. Live scan durations/animated progress header are explicitly outside comparisons.
state_oracles: Before teardown independently check every survivor exact byte sequence and removed beta node_modules absence. Canceled interactions preserve all targets.
regression: Remove real regex filtering in upstream TS; rebuild real compiled module, unchanged absence/snapshot fails; restore and rebuild then replay all contracts.
saved_state: Force actual deletion call into dry-run while UI still marks deleted; unchanged filesystem oracle must reject real remaining directory; restore/rebuild and recheck.
maintenance: Primary rerecord, manual filtered scan exact q exit, intentional alpha filter selected-baseline update followed by ordinary test.
exclusions: Host/home scanning, delete-all, sensitive path detection, permission handling, shell/file explorer, multi-select/range and exact size accounting.
